dict.string: Church Studio listens so it can suggest the verse being read. The suggestion stays on Preview until you press LIVE.
Church Studio shows your cameras, including phone cameras like Iriun, on Preview and on Program when you take them.
macOS shares the name of your Wi-Fi network only with apps allowed to use Location. Church Studio shows it so you know which network the TV must join. Your location is never used or sent.

Church Studio finds your church's other computers on this network, so pictures and videos come from the computer next door instead of the internet.
Church Studio uses on-device speech recognition to detect scripture. It does not send Program by itself.
